sources.entry: click - A package for creating beautiful command-line interfaces in a composable way.

summary.one_liner: Click is a Python package for building command-line interfaces by composing commands and options with decorators, with automatic help pages.
summary.what_it_does: Click lets you write command-line tools in Python with minimal code, using decorators to declare commands and options. The README says it supports arbitrary nesting of commands, so subcommands can contain their own subcommands. It generates help pages automatically from the command definitions and docstrings. It also supports lazy loading of subcommands at runtime. The example shows an option with a default value and an option that prompts the user for input when not supplied. Output is produced with click.echo.
use_cases: load CLI subcommands lazily at runtime
notable: Lazy loading of subcommands at runtime
Built-in prompting for missing option values
caveats: The README does not state installation commands or supported Python versions in the provided text
Donation and contributing sections are not summarized
